summary_en: Arakawa Chemical raised full-year dividend forecast to 70.00 yen per share from 55.00 yen, comprising 67.00 yen ordinary dividend and 3.00 yen commemorative dividend. The increase reflects upward revision of FY2027 earnings driven by strong sales in semiconductor and AI-related materials.
title_en: Notice Regarding Upward Revision of FY2027 Consolidated Business Forecast for Second Quarter (Interim Period) and Full Year, and Dividend Forecast Revision (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Arakawa Chemical Industries revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027, raising the full-year payout from 55.00 yen per share to 70.00 yen per share. The revised figure comprises 67.00 yen in ordinary dividend and 3.00 yen in commemorative dividend, compared to the previous forecast of 52.00 yen ordinary dividend and 3.00 yen commemorative dividend.

The dividend increase reflects an upward revision of the company's earnings guidance. Operating profit for the full year is now projected at 4,600 million yen, up 39.4% from the previous forecast of 3,300 million yen, while net income attributable to parent company shareholders is expected to reach 3,200 million yen, up 42.2% from the prior estimate of 2,250 million yen. Earnings per share is forecast at 161.30 yen, up from 113.41 yen.

The stronger earnings reflect brisk sales of photocurable resins and precision polishing agents for hard disk drives, driven by expanded demand in semiconductor, generative AI, and data center-related sectors. The company also cited temporary demand surge attributable to the Middle East situation and successful price revisions reflecting higher raw material costs as factors supporting the improved outlook.
